slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: The compilation states that registrars at municipal civil status bureaus record events by hand in paper registers and then transcribe them into the national Madania digital system, a central database; it gives no date for this, so the document's published date is used.

The compilation, citing the Centre of Excellence for CRVS Systems, states that civil status digitisation began in major municipalities in the 1980s and reached full national rollout by 2005, interconnecting all of more than 350 principal and subsidiary offices; the count is of offices, not of municipalities, and no denominator of municipalities is given.

systems.tiers: Municipal civil status bureaus, principal and subsidiary offices, annexes and mobile units; more than 350 offices
